desc: Imagica is a large amusement park located in Khopoli, Maharashtra, about 80 km from Mumbai. Opened in 2013, it is one of India's largest theme parks spread over 130 acres. The park features themed zones including an amusement park, water park, and snow park. It has over 20 rides and attractions including roller coasters, water slides, and 4D experiences. Imagica is built on the concept of 'Indianness' with themed areas inspired by Indian culture and mythology. It is a flagship project of the Adlabs Entertainment Group.
fact: It is one of India's largest theme parks spread over 130 acres · Opened in 2013 in Khopoli, Maharashtra · It features over 20 rides including roller coasters and a water park · It is a flagship project of Adlabs Entertainment Group

desc: EsselWorld is one of India's oldest and largest amusement parks, located in Gorai, Mumbai. Established in 1989, it is spread over 60 acres on a peninsula surrounded by the Gorai Creek. The park features over 40 rides and attractions including water rides, roller coasters, and a dedicated kids' zone. It also includes Asia's largest theme water park, Water Kingdom, adjacent to it. EsselWorld has been a iconic family entertainment destination for over three decades and is part of the Essel Group. The park is accessible by ferry from Borivali.
fact: It is one of India's oldest amusement parks, established in 1989 · It features over 40 rides spread over 60 acres in Gorai, Mumbai · It includes Asia's largest theme water park, Water Kingdom · It is accessible by ferry from Borivali in Mumbai

desc: Wonderla Bengaluru is a premier amusement park located on the Mysuru Road in Bengaluru. Opened in 2002, it is one of the most popular themed entertainment parks in South India. The park features over 50 rides including high-thrill rides, water rides, and family attractions. It includes a large wave pool, rain dance floor, and a unique musical fountain. Wonderla is known for its safety standards, cleanliness, and lush landscaping. It is part of the Wonderla Holidays group, which operates parks in Kochi, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. The park has won multiple awards for best amusement park in India.
fact: It features over 50 rides including high-thrill and water rides · Opened in 2002, it is one of South India's most popular amusement parks · It includes a large wave pool and musical fountain · It is part of Wonderla Holidays with parks in three Indian cities

desc: Wonderla Kochi is a major amusement park located in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala. Opened in 2000, it is the flagship property of Wonderla Holidays and was the first major themed entertainment park in Kerala. The park features over 50 rides and attractions with a mix of dry and water rides. The park is built on 30 acres with extensive landscaping and a scenic lake. It includes the largest wave pool in India and gravity-defying thrill rides. The park maintains high international safety standards and is ISO 14001 certified for environmental management.
fact: It is the flagship property of Wonderla Holidays, opened in 2000 · It features over 50 rides on 30 acres in Kakkanad, Kochi · It has the largest wave pool in India · It is ISO 14001 certified for environmental management

desc: Ramoji Film City is the world's largest film studio complex and a major tourist attraction located near Hyderabad, Telangana. Established in 1996, it is spread over 1,666 acres and is certified by Guinness World Records as the largest film studio complex in the world. The complex features over 40 film sets, amusement rides, gardens, and entertainment zones. It offers studio tours, live shows, and themed attractions showcasing Indian cinema. It attracts over 1.5 million visitors annually and is one of India's most popular entertainment destinations. The complex also houses hotels, convention centers, and post-production facilities.
fact: It is the world's largest film studio complex certified by Guinness World Records · It is spread over 1,666 acres near Hyderabad, established in 1996 · It attracts over 1.5 million visitors annually · It features over 40 film sets, amusement rides, and live entertainment shows

desc: MGM Dizzee World is an amusement park located on the East Coast Road near Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Established in 1993, it is one of the oldest amusement parks in South India. The park features a mix of dry and water rides with over 30 attractions including roller coasters, bumper cars, and water slides. It is known for its family-friendly environment and affordable pricing. The park underwent major renovations and expansion in 2015 with new rides and themed areas. It is part of the MGM Group of entertainment venues in Chennai.
fact: It is one of the oldest amusement parks in South India, established in 1993 · It features over 30 dry and water rides on East Coast Road, Chennai · It underwent major expansion in 2015 with new rides · It is known for its family-friendly environment and affordable pricing
